evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label, introduces util::SplitLines in src/util/string.h, and modifies Logger formatting in src/logging.cpp to escape newlines.
rationale: Prevents untrusted user inputs from forging fake log lines across node logging. As shown in the description's reproducible script, unescaped newlines allow restricted callers or external daemons to forge critical lines such as 'ERROR: ConnectTip: ConnectBlock ... failed' in debug.log, misleading monitoring systems and node operators.
